payload.core_mechanism_summary: Two DP arrays m1, m2 indexed by integer, updated per element: m1[a+1] accumulates combinations from m1[a] and m1[a+1]; m2[a-1] adds from m1[a-1] and m2[a-1]; ans aggregates counts.
payload.rationale: The state is two-dimensional (value index and type flags) tracked separately as two arrays, perfectly matching dp_2d_state which involves DP with two dimensions or states.
